build_docker_images_for_lang: build all interop docker images for a specified language across releases and runtimes
add_files_to_image: add extra files like commit logs to an existing docker image with a label
checkout_grpc_stack: clone and checkout a gRPC git repo at a specific release tag for building
apply_patches_on_git_tag: apply a git patch file to a checked out release tag for interop test compatibility
upload_images_to_gcr: push built docker images to Google Container Registry using gcloud docker push
